description: This file defines an interface ITaskService for task management operations within the API, including methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting tasks asynchronously.

classes.name: ITaskService
classes.description: An interface for task-related operations in the API, providing methods to get all tasks, get a task by ID, create, update, and delete tasks asynchronously.

methods.name: GetAllAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves all tasks, optionally cancellable via a CancellationToken.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a task by its unique identifier, optionally cancellable.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new task based on the provided DTO.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates an existing task identified by ID with data from the provided DTO.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a task identified by ID.
